messages.subject: Issues Deploying App to shinyapp.io
parts:
I keep getting the following errors when I try to deploy my app. "Error in library(googleVis) : there is no package called ‘googleVis’
Calls: local ... sourceUTF8 -> source -> withVisible -> eval -> eval -> library
Execution halted" This error appears on the url where my app should be, not in my R Console.  The app runs fine on my machine. 
This doesn't just happen for googleVis but also for forecast, reshape and others. 
I have updated R to the latest version, followed the instructions on your website. I installed all current required packages. It still won't deploy. I had no issues deploying other apps back in july. Any ideas to help me out? Thanks.

Anthony,

Are you trying to access a file from your local computer on shinyapps.io? If so, you should ensure that all files needed by your application are bundled with your application by placing them in the same directory (or subdirectory) of your ui.R / server.R files.

-Andy
